evidence.quote: I find it appropriate to hold our policy rate at the current level for some time.
Both headline and core inflation have shown no progress in the last six months.
there are many reasons to think that larger effects of tariffs are still coming.
Overall, I see the labor market as stable and resilient, and economic activity moderating some.
This still-restrictive policy stance is important to keep longer-run inflation expectations anchored.

parsed.rationale: The speaker forcefully emphasizes upside inflation risks from tariffs and geopolitics, describes the labor market as resilient, and calls for holding rates for some time, pushing back against near-term cuts. No hike is signaled, so the stance is moderately hawkish.
